metadata.title: LAMAK updated-workbook optimization v5
metadata.method: updated workbook cached formula results from 9 source/calculation sheets; exact core with staged packaging; no preset portfolio or historical sensitivity snapshots
metadata.financialConvention: opex excludes D&A; EBIT savings = -opex - depreciation - setup in implementation year
metadata.energyMethod: Average daily PV energy offsets mean site daily load, no credit for surplus; verified against Energy rows 6-17
metadata.energyClarification: The workbook labels one installation, daily average PV offset and heating factor interpretation as professor confirmed; this was not independently verified.
metadata.stockUncertainty: 20% annual carrying rate and €0 fixed order cost are analyst assumptions, not case facts
metadata.electricEligibility: Based on the workbook Transport rows and its adjacency rules, not independently confirmed by professor

sourceControls.DC: at most one first-year relocation, €90,000 setup
sourceControls.supplier: one alternative share tier per material
sourceControls.packaging: monotone staged 33/66/100 adoption with incremental token charges and setup once; source allows progressive implementation
sourceControls.transport: one fuel per route / geographical area
